description: shared_ptr lets several pointers own one object. A reference count records those owners, and the object is deleted when the count reaches zero.

steps.description: Node stores its next link as a shared_ptr. Its constructor and destructor contain diagnostic messages.
make_shared creates the Node and its first owner. Copying a into b and c adds owners inside the nested block.
Leaving the inner block removes b and c. Leaving the function removes a, the last owner.
cycle_demo creates two separately owned Nodes.
Each next link becomes an owner of the other Node. This ownership cycle keeps both reference counts above zero.

title: Track shared ownership and cycles
